text: Major flaw ruins the app completely. I love the dictation, and the AI voice works great, but this app has one major issue that makes it very frustrating to use. By default, when you open the keyboard, it just opens an icon to start talking—no actual keyboard. You constantly have to switch between keyboard and voice when you need to type anything.
